_comment: Example config. Run `npm run init` to generate your own book.config.json — you should not need to edit this by hand.
title: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 9: The Beautiful Place
author: Matt Dinniman
_anchorPostId: The first post of the book. Nothing published before it is ever included.
_include: Post titles matching this (case-insensitive regex) count as story content.
_exclude: Applied after include; drops announcements that mention chapters in passing.
_overrides: Escape hatches for posts the filters get wrong. Post ids as strings.
_collectionUrl: Optional. Build from a Patreon collection instead: it replaces anchorPostId, include, exclude and extraPostIds. skipPostIds still applies.
_collectionOrder: published (by date), collection (as the creator arranged it), or collection-reversed.
